Why go: an easy sail from the north coast

If you are staying in Bang Rak, Bophut, Plai Laem or Choeng Mon, Winner is the most convenient private sailing catamaran: it leaves from right on your doorstep. The half day is a relaxed format. You sail past Big Buddha and along the coast, anchor off Koh Som for swimming, snorkelling and paddle boarding, and are back by lunchtime, or by sunset if you take the afternoon trip. The full day crosses to Koh Phangan's quieter bays, with a promise to stay on the Samui coast at the same price if the crossing is too rough.

A crew of two handles the boat. Fishing gear, a paddle board and snorkel gear are always on board, and one cabin gives shade and a place to change.

Who it suits, and who should choose something else

  • Good for: couples, families and groups of up to 16 staying on the north and north-east coasts, and first-time sailors who want a short, gentle trip.
  • Choose something else if: you're staying in the south-west. The Aloha leaves from Lipa Noi and is sheltered in the monsoon. If you want air-conditioned cabins, look at the Elizabeth.

Good to know

  • Season: the north coast is most exposed from October to December. Mornings are usually calmer then.
  • Lunch: order the Thai BBQ in advance, or bring a picnic. There is nowhere to buy food at anchor.
  • Getting there: the boat is 10–20 minutes by road from Chaweng and Bophut.
  • Bigger groups: up to 16 guests can come, with a per-person fee above 8. Message us before booking.
  • Snorkelling: visibility around Koh Som is best on calm, sunny mornings.
